source_policy: Use official normative references for design; before runtime load pin exact RDF artifact/version/ontology IRI/byte SHA256 and review actual redistribution rights. Do not copy unreviewed publisher RDF into repository.

registrations.name: GeoSPARQL 1.1
registrations.notes: GeoSPARQL Next draft is not automatically selected; check official 1.1 ontology file metadata, license and test actual GeoSPARQL queries before imports.

registrations.name: OGC CRS84
registrations.description: WGS 84 longitude-latitude reference system used as default for GeoSPARQL WKT literals without explicit SRS IRI, OGC 22-047r1 requirement 15
registrations.purpose: Explicit CRS IRI in pilot WKT; lon lat coordinate order
registrations.notes: Do not conflate EPSG:4326 axis order with CRS84. CRS URI is a reference, not a vendored ontology artifact.

registrations.name: RDF 1.1 Concepts / Dataset
registrations.purpose: Distinguish named graphs from default graph; no graph epistemic authorization inferred

registrations.name: SPARQL 1.1 Query
registrations.purpose: GRAPH keyword, explicit active graph selection for leakage oracles

registrations.name: P04 T-04 eight pinned RDF snapshots
registrations.purpose: Reuse existing SOSA/SSN/QUDT/OWL-Time/PROV-O source controls; do not update their bytes in P05-00
registrations.notes: Do not infer that P05 GeoSPARQL is included in the P04 T-04 set.

preimplementation_gates: Choose exact OGC GeoSPARQL ontology artifact and ontology/version IRIs from the file; preserve reviewed publisher license and SHA-256.
Determine whether GeoSPARQL conformance class and required sfWithin/sfIntersects/geof:distance functions are actually supported by the selected query engine.
Specify canonical CRS, geometry lexical rules and reprojection provenance, with positive and negative tests.
Make source-profile loading explicit and deterministic; no network calls or implicit RDF imports during CI.
Record a separate owner-reviewed P05 source/redistribution decision before committing new vendor snapshots.
